title: Groove
description: Five real kinds of vinyl pressing drawn from scratch: two zoetrope picture discs, a picture disc, a splatter and an etched B-side. At 33⅓ under a 20 Hz strobe the zoetrope's 36 drawings line up and the birds flap, the balls bounce and the dots pulse; drag the record by hand and they stall, slip and run backwards, and switch the strobe off to see them smear into a blur.
intent: One real optical trick finished to the edge: the animation is not played, it falls out of the record's rotation and the strobe, so the right speed is what brings the drawings to life.
